newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: One hurt in clash over APEC - radio.
newsitem.headline: One hurt in clash over APEC - radio.

text.p: At least one person was injured on Monday when supporters and opponents of APEC clashed near the summit venue, a Manila radio station said.
"They're hitting each other and one anti-APEC rallyist is bleeding," a reporter of radio station DZRH said in a broadcast from the scene.
The APEC supporters were armed with clubs and one of the anti-APEC protesters was hit over the head, the radio said.
Police were trying to break up the two groups, the radio said.

Olongapo is the town outside Subic Bay, the former U.S. naval base where U.S. President Bill Clinton and other leaders of the 18 member economies of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum were holding their fourth annual summit.
